name: Ekajuk
family: Niger-Congo, Atlantic-Congo, Volta-Congo, Benue-Congo, Bantoid, Southern, Ekoid

tones.high: marked with an acute accent (e.g., á, ń, ḿ)

notes: Ekajuk orthography uses 'h' frequently; while it may mark tone, downstep, or vowel length in certain native contexts, it is mapped here to /h/ to correctly handle its consonantal use in names and loans. The letter ꞌ (saltillo) is mapped to a glottal stop /ʔ/.
